# Full local topic procedures and data

Load the needed topic/phase, not the whole corpus. Every retained file has exact
pinned provenance and recorded substitutions in the source manifest. The
[Design process](../README.md) reconciles authority and effects. Source code
examples are inert knowledge until applied by an authorized actual target owner.
